name: Prop
description: A Prop represents a Dynamic Mesh which can be spawned in the world, can be grabbed around by characters and have physics.

parameters.name: collision_type
parameters.description: Setting CollisionType.Auto will make it automatically switch between Normal and IgnoreOnlyPawn if they are smaller than radius 40 units.

parameters.name: grab_mode
parameters.description: Whether or not the Prop can be grabbed

parameters.name: ccd_mode
parameters.description: Whether or not the Prop should have CCD enabled (disabling it may cause Props passing through objects if it's kinda small). It's smart to force it disabled on 'visual only' props.

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

functions.name: SetGrabMode
functions.description: Sets ability to Characters to Grab this Prop

parameters.name: grab_mode
parameters.description: If the Prop will be able to be grabbable or not. Set to Auto to automatically define based on Prop's size.

functions.name: SetInteractionToolTipText
functions.description: Sets the interaction tooltip text shown when a Character interacts with this Prop

parameters.name: tool_tip_text
parameters.description: Text to show in the interaction tooltip

functions.name: SetPhysicsDamping
functions.description: Sets the Physics damping of this Prop

functions.name: GetHandler
functions.description: Gets the Character (if existing) which is holding this

return.description: the character that holds the object
return.name: handler

functions.name: GetGrabMode
functions.description: Gets ability to Grab this Prop

functions.name: SetMassOverride
functions.description: Override the mass (in Kg) of this Prop

parameters.name: mass
parameters.description: Mass in KG to override. Pass -1 to reset to default

functions.name: SetMassScale
functions.description: Change the mass scale used to calculate the mass of this Prop

functions.name: SetBuoyancyPontoons
functions.description: Sets the Buoyancy Pontoons used by the Water simulation
functions.description_long:
Sets the spherical Pontoons used to float this entity on Water, overriding the ones automatically calculated from the Mesh bounds and mass.

Pass no value (or an empty table) to go back to the automatically calculated ones.

Pontoons only have an effect on Maps with Water Buoyancy enabled

parameters.name: pontoons
parameters.description: Array with the Pontoons, or nil to restore the automatically calculated ones

table_properties.name: Radius
table_properties.description: Radius of the Pontoon sphere, must be greater than 0

functions.name: SetBuoyancySettings
functions.description: Sets how this entity behaves on Water
functions.description_long:
Any value passed as nil restores that setting's default.

While the Pontoons are being automatically calculated, changing buoyancy_coefficient also recalculates them, as their radius derives from it.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether Buoyancy forces are applied at all

parameters.name: buoyancy_coefficient
parameters.description: How much it floats, the higher the more

parameters.name: buoyancy_damp
parameters.description: First order damping on the vertical velocity, reduces bobbing

parameters.name: max_buoyant_force
parameters.description: Clamp on the upwards force, stops light objects being launched out of the water

events.name: Grab
events.description: Triggered when Character grabs a Prop

events.name: Hit
events.description: Triggered when this Prop hits something

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The prop which has been hit

arguments.name: impact_force
arguments.description: The intensity of the Hit normalized by the Prop's weight

arguments.name: impact_location
arguments.description: The world 3D location of the impact

arguments.name: velocity
arguments.description: The Prop velocity at the moment it hits

arguments.name: other_actor
arguments.description: The other actor that hit this Prop

events.name: Interact
events.description: When a Character interacts with this Prop (i.e. try to Grab it)

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: the object that undergoes an interaction

arguments.name: character
arguments.description: the character who interacts with the object

return.description: Return false to prevent the interaction (i.e. prevent being grabbed)

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: the object that takes the damage

arguments.name: from_direction
arguments.description: Direction of the damage relative to the damaged actor

arguments.name: instigator
arguments.description: The player which caused the damage

arguments.name: causer
arguments.description: The object which caused the damage

events.name: UnGrab
events.description: Triggered when this Prop is ungrabbed

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The prop which has been ungrabbed
